english.title: Trader sell regulated timeshare contract as an investment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a trader,

(A)_[marketed]_
(B)_[sold]_

a proposed

(C)_[timeshare]_
(D)_[long-term holiday product]_

contract as an investment when it would have been a regulated contract
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(5) and 27 of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit on Prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
